topic: The Oscar winner who threw their award in the trash the very next morning
hook: She won the Oscar. She threw it in the trash next morning.
script: She won the Oscar. She threw it in the trash next morning. Screenwriter William Goldman left his Oscar for Butch Cassidy on a New York sidewalk as a statement about Hollywood's obsession with awards. Several Oscar winners have publicly discarded or auctioned their statuettes. Marlon Brando sent a Native American activist to refuse his on stage. George C Scott refused his entirely. The most prestigious award in film has been rejected more times than most people know. Follow for Oscar moments Hollywood doesn't want to replay.
